\section[\texorpdfstring{\kn{ಗುಣವಾಗು} (guṇavāgu)}{ಗುಣವಾಗು (guṇavāgu)}]{\kn{ಗುಣವಾಗು} (guṇavāgu) — to get well, to heal}

\label{lesson:KA-C200-gunavagu}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Kannada for to iron, then the Kannada for to change.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \kn{ಗುಣವಾಗು}}
\textbf{\kn{ಗುಣವಾಗು}} — \emph{guṇavāgu} — \textquotedblleft{}to get well, to heal\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\kn{ಗುಣವಾಗು}} (\emph{guṇavāgu}) is \emph{guṇa}, \textquotedblleft{}good quality, health\textquotedblright{}, from Sanskrit \emph{guṇa} (CDIAL 4190), with native \emph{āgu}, \textquotedblleft{}to become\textquotedblright{} (DEDR 333): \textquotedblleft{}to become well\textquotedblright{}. DEDR 333 compares Sanskrit \emph{ām}.
\end{cousinweb}
